item.title: Tatton takes management in house following slew of senior hires

item.title: How AI is helping property brands actually stand out
item.description: If you sell or let homes or commercial space in the UK, you’re operating in a market where the product is physical, but the first viewing is digital. Buyers, tenants and agents don’t just compare floor plates and EPCs; they compare experiences, writes Daniel Swepson of Next Chapter and Show + Tell. The post How AI is helping property brands actually stand out appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: VIDEO | How technology is reducing construction waste
item.description: Embracing digital platforms allows the industry to easily and quickly connect companies with surplus soil with others who need it.
